row.evidence: Harness documents SCIM provisioning of users and groups from Okta, Microsoft Entra ID and OneLogin ("so you create, update, and remove them in Okta instead of in Harness"), but neither the pricing page (Free, Essentials and Enterprise, the paid plans Contact Sales) nor the docs say which plan includes SCIM or SSO.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. SCIM exists but its plan gate is not public, so status is unknown rather than gated: the pricing page lists a Free plan and two Contact Sales plans (Essentials bundle, up to 500 users; modular Enterprise) and has no SSO or SCIM line, and no developer.harness.io page ties SAML or SCIM to a plan. SCIM base URL is per cluster (https://app.harness.io/gateway/ng/api/scim/account/{accountId}, plus Prod2/Prod3/Prod0-4/EU and self-managed variants), authenticated with a Harness API key token (bearer; optional expiry) or JWT. Catalogue apps provision in Okta (OIN: SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push, Group Linking), Entra (gallery app with Microsoft provisioning tutorial) and OneLogin; Entra syncs about every 40 minutes. Only names, email and display name sync; roles and resource groups are assigned in Harness. SAML JIT and LDAP group linking are alternatives. A REST API (x-api-key) can add, list, update and remove users and manage user groups, and an audit-events API exists.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: All-in-one DevOps bundle (CI, CD, IaC, security); up to 500 users per the comparison table.

auth.token_source: Harness API key token (personal or service account) with Users and User Groups permissions; JWT optional
auth.token_expiry: optional expiration date set per token

operations.notes: Okta Deactivate Users and OneLogin 'When users are deleted: Delete' remove the user from Harness; PUT vs PATCH not documented.

custom.how: Only the listed fields sync; OneLogin accepts first name, last name and email only.

attributes.notes: Okta docs name the synced profile fields (given name, family name, primary email, primary email type, display name) rather than SCIM paths; userName is the unique identifier.

roles.how: Roles and resource groups are assigned to provisioned groups in Harness, not by the IdP.

limitations.text: Entra changes sync about every 40 minutes.
OneLogin role-based groups are not removed automatically; Harness Support must delete them.
OneLogin accepts only first name, last name and email.

scim.notes: Base URL differs by cluster (Prod2 /gateway/gratis/, Prod3 app3.harness.io, Prod0/Prod4 accounts.harness.io, EU accounts.eu.harness.io without /gateway) and self-managed installs.

auth.notes: x-api-key header; tokens inherit the permissions of their user or service account.

capabilities.notes: 'Add user(s) to scope' adds/invites users; 'Remove user' removes the collaborator from a scope; role assignments have their own endpoints.

audit_log_api.notes: Audit trail kept up to 2 years; audit streaming is also available.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push and Group Linking; Harness's own Okta SCIM guide uses a custom SAML app with SCIM instead.

onelogin.notes: Per Harness's OneLogin guide; OneLogin catalogue page not loaded.

fallbacks.other_sync: LDAP group linking to Harness user groups
